title: Verify: Me endpoint 401 and 200 unit tests
summary: Tests for me endpoint valid, missing, tampered, wrong-secret and expired tokens
description: Offline httptest table tests using fixed clock.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid token, when Me is called, then 200 and the player id are asserted
Given missing, tampered, wrong-secret, expired or garbage tokens, when Me is called, then 401 is asserted

steps.action: With fixed Now, create token via Sign(secret,'p1',Now); GET Me with cookie; assert 200 and body id 'p1'
Table test: no cookie, token with last char flipped, token signed with secret 'other', token issued 2h ago with TTL 1h, and garbage 'xyz'; assert each returns 401
Using server.New and httptest.NewRecorder (no live port), POST session, copy the Set-Cookie into a GET /api/v1/player/me request, assert 200 and the same id
